title: Career Roadmap · Legal Advisor
summary: A Legal Advisor provides legal guidance to individuals, businesses, institutions or organizations. The role involves interpreting laws, reviewing contracts, identifying legal risks, preparing opinions, supporting compliance, conducting legal research and helping management make legally informed decisions.

facts.Current degree: Law - LLB / BA LLB / BBA LLB / B.Com LLB / B.Sc LLB (Integrated)
